reviews.review:
Are you looking for a game where you can click on the entire picture in search of particularly hard-to-find cats without any hint? Well you found it!!!!
In each of the pictures you have to find different cats, some of them very well hidden. There are also 2 extras. Each image has a sublevel. The cats there count towards the overall result! And then unfortunately there are the cats that are particularly hard to find. These can be hidden somewhere within the image...no clue as to where they might be...so you really have to click off everything.
Oh yes, it should be mentioned that in the sublevel it is not shown whether you have found all the cats... have fun.
It's also nice that parts of the picture are colored when you've found the cats there...well, but the hard-to-find cats can still be in these colored parts.

Overall...the game is not fun.
I will ask for a refund!!!
